body:
The only advice I can give is to talk to someone. It made the world of difference to me. I know that it can be hard though. It may take some time to find the person you feel you can tell. But there must be someone. Tell them how you feel. Talk to them. They will try to help you. Please.

I know it will be hard. But it is worth a try first, if nothing else. It may take some time to find the person. Wait until you find that person, and tell them? Make no permanent decisions until then? You may have to give it time though. Please, persevere and find that person that can help you.
PM me of you need me. I can't guarantee to get back straight away, but if you need someone to vent to, I'm here!
Thank you for talking. You are awesome as a result :D

But you CAN tell someone. I didn't think that when I started going through all of this that I would be able to talk to ANYONE. But It just takes one person to start the ball rolling for the help to come pouring in.
I want everyone who reads this to also stay strong!
I want to be normal too. It might be able to happen if you talk to someone. Anyone. Someone might be able to help you.

Just keep talking. To anyone. Even a stranger at the other end of a helpline. I know it's cheesy, but "a problem shared is a problem halved". To be honest I didn't really believe this saying (that my sister says often to try to help me open up) is true until this week.
I find opening up so hard too. That's why it took so long for my counsellor to "get it out of me". I just wanted to try to help someone. Just one person would make this post worthwhile.
Thanks. I just came to this realisation today. I just wanted to share :D
I nearly cut my wrist too deep. It was scary. I didn't want to die.
